assessment.material: Mine-discarded kaolin from Caobar SA dumps, Poveda de la Sierra, Spain; uncommercial high-iron beds, not established processing tailings.
assessment.source: 10.1007/s42860-022-00192-7; Clays and Clay Minerals70(3):386–404; original Springer7July2022. Crossref current online date2024-01-01 reflects later hosting and is not a second experiment.
assessment.primary_access: Complete19-page primaryPDF, original publisher Figures1–12 (Fig4 split into two image files), all Tables1–4; whole text extracted and read. Relevant pages4,6–14 and originalFig10–12 visually inspected. Main originalplots all inspected through PDF renders; not merely abstract review.
assessment.supplement_access: Complete original ESM1 DOCX opened as OOXML, all text and four embedded images inspected; two versions of geological map, outcrop image, mid-assay suspension image. FiguresS1–S3, no hidden supplementary biological dataset.
assessment.feed: High/low-iron feeds92.20/97.00mass%kaolinite plus quartz/muscovite;3.06/0.34mass%Fe2O3. These are not elemental Fe percentages or pure mineral species.
assessment.organism: Source isolate91 from Madrid wastewater biological reactor, identified according to GenBank as Bacillus thuringiensisEB63; no sequence accession supplied. NCBITaxon1428 verified at issuing authority solely for species label; no strain ID or genomics inferred. Isolate37 discarded before assays.
assessment.assay: Autoclave121°C20min;12.5g/250mL medium plus1mL inoculum;14days; independent duplicatesD1/D2; high-iron cultured, low-iron cultured, high-iron uninoculated. No matched low-iron control, no EDTA-free or pH-matched control shown. Glucose20g/L and disodiumEDTA0.75g/L; complete medium in record.
assessment.inoculum: LB reactivation30°C24h; OD0.1~5e4CFU/mL in saline stock before assay dilution; clumps explicitly noted. Leaching incubation temperature not unambiguously given.
assessment.analytical: 0.45then0.22micrometre filtrates; totalFeAAS; FeIIphenanthroline; FeIIIby subtraction. GC-MS lauricacid percentage area, not absoluteconcentration. Generalmethods claim analyticaltriplicates; bioResults duplicate analyses.
assessment.outcome: High-iron biotic Fe exceeds control bars but modestD1endpointdifference, no supplied significance test. Source-reported maximum0.83%gross elimination with exactarm/time/calculation notprovided; denominator cannot be independentlyclosed. D2day7totalFe14.9mg/L inFig9caption agrees with~4+11mg/L inFig11 butFig10bar is clipped at6mg/L. Do not digitize clippedbar as6or recalculate a new acceptedyield.
